entry.title: what i learned about whitespace
entry.content:
Short post: whitespace is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Whitespace shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: a small guide to whitespace
entry.content:
Every few months whitespace bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Whitespace shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
